# 36th Luna Awards

|site=Resorts World Manila|host=|producer=|director=|organizer=|best_picture=Ang Larawan|most_wins=Ang Larawan
Changing Partners (10)|network=|ratings=|last=35th|next=37th}}The 36th Luna Awards ceremony, presented by the Film Academy of the Philippines (FAP), honored the best Filipino films of 2017. It took place on September 29, 2018 at the Resorts World Manila in Pasay, Philippines.
